description: This file defines the GroupModel class, which manages a group of services, including their configuration, invocation modes, and execution logic within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GroupModel
classes.description: Represents a group of services with configurable invocation modes, capable of executing all, one, or a round-robin sequence of services.

methods.name: GroupModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GroupModel from an XML DOM Element, parsing service definitions and attributes.

methods.name: GroupModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GroupModel with explicit parameters: group name, send mode, and list of services.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service group.

methods.name: getSendMode
methods.description: Returns the invocation mode for the service group.

methods.name: getServices
methods.description: Returns the list of services in the group.

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Indicates whether the group is optional.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the group of services according to the configured send mode, handling all, round-robin, random, first-available, or none.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the GroupModel.

methods.name: runAll
methods.description: Invokes all services in the group sequentially, aggregating results and handling errors.

methods.name: runIndex
methods.description: Invokes a single service at the specified index.

methods.name: runOne
methods.description: Invokes services one by one until one succeeds or all fail.
